info.name: Maps Raster API
info.description:
The Maps API web services suite offers the following APIs:
- Raster
The Maps Raster API renders map data that is divided into gridded sections called tiles.

query.description: Layer of image to be rendered. Hybrid and labels are intended for layering with other data and are only available in png format.
Map style to be returned
Image format to be returned
Zoom level of map image to be returned.
Coordinates for the center point of the image. Must be used with the width and height parameters; cannot be used with bbox. Uses EPSG:3857 projection (functionally equivalent to EPSG:900910).
Width of the resulting image in pixels. Width must be a positive integer between 1 and 8192.
Height of the resulting image in pixels. Height must be a positive integer between 1 and 8192.

Bounding box for the image, using EPSG:3857 projection (functionally equivalent to EPSG:900910). Values must be in the order of minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat. MaxLat must be greater than minLat. Longitude values can be on both sides of the 180th meridian. Cannot be used with center, width, or height parameters.
Geopolitical view. Determines rendering of disputed areas. See the documentation for an explanation of how this works in live services.

variable.description: (Required) Version of the service to call. The current version is 1.

request.description:
The Static Image service renders a rectangular raster image
in the style, size, and zoom level specified. The image can be requested
using either a center point plus width and height or a bounding box.
